releaseNotes: Added Macro Recorder with recording, playback, a floating control strip, and driver-enhanced playback support through Interception when installed.
Improved macro playback accuracy, emergency stop cleanup, loop controls, and recorder workflow so macros can be tested before saving.
Added All Tools search filtering and startup settings for opening minimized to tray so reminders can keep working in the background.
Improved Reminder smart-title parsing for dates, shorthand durations, and larger values without crashing.
Polished settings, About details, and macro recorder UI layout.
